claims.statement: From 18 February 2027, covered LMT, industrial batteries above 2 kWh, and EV batteries must have a battery passport with item-specific information.
The Batteries Regulation provides lawful purchasers and their agents read-only access to state-of-health and lifetime parameters for residual-value, further-use, and aggregation purposes.
Demand hypothesis: binding test and history packets will cause qualified buyers to bid earlier and with a narrower risk discount.

contrary_evidence: Passport access is tiered and does not make every field public.
Low-value or damaged batteries may remain economical only as regulated waste.

economics.acquisition_route: Demand hypothesis: one fleet or storage maintainer with a predictable replacement schedule seeds both supply and buyer outreach
economics.founder_net_worth_path: Hypothesis: 5000 packs yearly at 700 PLN blended revenue produces 3.5m PLN revenue; at 25% EBITDA and a 6x niche-data marketplace value, founder equity could exceed 5m PLN in 5-7 years
economics.founder_time: 15-20 hours weekly to build the data workflow and manage partners; no inventory ownership
economics.gross_margin_basis: Economics hypothesis: 65-80% platform margin excluding third-party testing passed through at cost
economics.payback: Economics hypothesis: 150 packs at 600 PLN plus 20 transactions averaging 2500 PLN fee recover setup capital in 12-18 months
economics.pricing: Economics hypothesis: 300-900 PLN per verified pack plus 1.5-3% of transaction value and optional buyer subscriptions
economics.retention_or_repeat: Fleet replacement cycles, updated health readings, and repeat buyer specifications create recurring transactions

fingerprint.compounding_advantage: Serial-level state-of-health histories, realized resale values, tester performance, and recurring buyer specifications
fingerprint.customer: EV fleets, stationary-storage owners, lessors, refurbishers, second-life integrators, and recyclers
fingerprint.distribution_mechanism: Battery service firms, fleet-management providers, storage installers, leasing firms, and qualified reuse operators
fingerprint.offer_and_business_model: Owner authorization, passport ingestion, independent test coordination, title documents, forward auction, and compliant waste fallback
fingerprint.payer_and_paid_event: Sellers pay per verified listing and buyers or sellers pay a transaction fee at contracted transfer
fingerprint.problem_trigger: A battery approaches removal but buyers cannot price residual life or distinguish a reusable unit from waste with confidence

founder_fit: AI can structure passports and documents
Part-time pilot possible with one battery class

structure.commercial_archetype: Owner-authorized forward marketplace with evidence escrow
structure.control_point: Verified title or disposal mandate bound to the serial-level battery evidence packet
structure.critical_dependency: Credible testing partners and lawful classification, transport, repurposing, or waste routing for every unit

thesis: Fleet, storage, and equipment owners authorize future battery listings; the exchange binds title, state-of-health tests, passport history, removal date, and qualified second-life buyers before decommissioning. Demand hypothesis: reliable evidence and forward visibility can reduce the adverse-selection discount in used batteries.
title: Battery Second-Life Rights and Evidence Exchange
